title: Who can rewrite fate?
literal_meaning: Who can alter what fate has written?
meaning_odia: ଭାଗ୍ୟରେ ଯାହା ଲେଖା ଅଛି, ତାହାକୁ କିଏ ବଦଳାଇ ପାରିବ—ଏହି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ଘଟଣାକୁ ନିଜ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ବାହାରର ବୋଲି ମାନିନେବାର ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି। ଭାଗ୍ୟକୁ ଏଠାରେ ବଦଳାଇ ହେଉନଥିବା ଲେଖା ପରି କଳ୍ପନା କରାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The question voices resignation: what has happened feels already written and beyond the speaker’s power to change. Its image is of destiny as a written record whose words cannot be altered. This is an editorial reading of the saying’s literal rhetorical question.
usage_example: After an unexpected cancellation ends a long-awaited visit, someone accepts the disappointment with “Who can rewrite fate?” This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ଲିଖନ turns destiny into writing, while ଆନ asks whether that writing can be made different. The unanswered question carries the sense that the speaker sees no way to change the outcome.

witnesses.note: Complete wording with ଲିଖନ and question mark. Supports display spelling against comparison extraction ଳିଖନ; uploaded two-line arrangement retained. Possible shared lineage.
Same lexical wording କରମ ଲିଖନ କେ କରିବ ଆନ, ending in a bar rather than question mark. No separate source gloss.

english_summary: A rhetorical question expresses resignation to what seems already written.
